title: Annotatio I §.V: Hoc pacto the controversy vanishes — tropus that keeps presence vs tropus that ejects it
pass_a_gloss: But by this pact the whole Controversy ceases entirely and vanishes — the Reformed defending a tropus indeed, but one that by no means suffers Christ’s body to be absent from the Supper, still less makes it so; the Lutherans on the other hand opposing a tropus that is less ashamed to move Christ’s body from the Supper and take His presence out of it.
pass_b_english: On that pact the whole controversy ceases and vanishes.

The Reformed defend a tropus that will not let Christ’s body be absent from the Supper — still less make it so; the Lutherans fight a tropus that is less shy about moving the body out and stripping presence from the meal.
source_text: Hoc verò pacto Controversia tota cessat omnino & evanescit, Reformatis tropum quidem defendentibus, sed qui corpus Christi Coenâ abesse haud patitur, nedum facit; Lutheranis verò tropo adversantibus, qui corpus Christi Coenâ movere ejusque praesentiam ex ea tollere minus verecundatur.

lemmas.gloss: by no means suffers absence from the Supper

notes: Controversy ceases; presence-keeping vs ejecting tropus.
